articles.title: Pakistan hosts talks with Saudi Arabia and Turkey under Mecca Pact
articles.description: PAKISTAN was set to host talks with Saudi Arabia and Turkey today under the Joint Mecca Defence Agreement, which treats an attack on any member as an attack on all three.Discussions in Islamabad will focus on developments in the Middle East, including ongoing attacks on Saudi Arabia by Yemen’s Houthi forces, according to sources.Pakistan has insisted the agreement is purely defensive in nature and not against any specific enemy, including Iran, and that the trilateral alliance reflects a shared desire to strengthen strategic security co-operation.
